features.description: Consumer-family taxonomy + evidence vocabulary. Map the existing 8 qa-sufficiency surface classes into two families (human, agent); add a consumer dimension to the journey model. Add a SINGLE CLOSED evidence_class enum plus a data_provenance marker as NEW optional fields on EvidenceRef WITHOUT inventing new EvidenceRef.type enum values: each evidence_class maps to a valid existing type, and data_provenance is one of seeded|real|degraded. Also add two structured fields to EvidenceRef so degradation/typed-skip and keyed cross-surface comparison are STRUCTURAL not prose: data_source (a stable key) and availability (available|unavailable). A typed-skip is represented as availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded — data_provenance is NOT extended with a skip value (D017).
features.acceptance: A pure module defines a CLOSED surface_class enum and SurfaceFamily. The surface_class enum is the canonical structural set derived from the 8 qa-sufficiency surface classes (D024): {read_only_ui, interactive_ui, mobile_app, cli_human, agent_mcp_tool, cli_agent, external_integration, service_batch}. A SINGLE CLOSED ClaimKind enum is defined once and referenced by F002: ClaimKind = {read_only, mutation, qualitative, error_path} (D058); unknown claim_kind values are rejected. The legacy qa class 'mutation' is NOT a surface_class — it is mapped to claim_kind=mutation (D014) and is therefore EXCLUDED from the surface-token domain: the TOTAL DETERMINISTIC 1:1 token->surface_class map (D050) covers ONLY the 8 surface tokens and never the legacy 'mutation' token, which migrates to claim_kind (D058). 'command (CLI)' splits into cli_human (human operator) vs cli_agent (the agent CLI transcript F003 captures); 'agent / MCP tool' is agent_mcp_tool; 'service / batch (backend/API)' is service_batch. A documented table maps each legacy-8 class AND each journey.surfaces token to a surface_class, PINNED (D050) as a TOTAL, DETERMINISTIC 1:1 map — exactly ONE surface_class per token, NO disjunction (D057): web->read_only_ui, web_interactive->interactive_ui, backend->service_batch, mcp_tool->agent_mcp_tool, cli_agent->cli_agent, cli_human->cli_human, ios->mobile_app, android->mobile_app, external->external_integration; an interactive web surface declares the web_interactive token (or surface_class=interactive_ui directly), never the bare web token; the enum is closed and unknown tokens are rejected fail-closed (unknown surface_class rejected). SurfaceFamily (human, agent) has a total, tested mapping from every surface_class member to exactly one family — PINNED (D049): human={read_only_ui, interactive_ui, mobile_app, cli_human}, agent={agent_mcp_tool, cli_agent, external_integration, service_batch}. The objective_contract UserJourney gains consumer (human|agent|both) — REQUIRED for any journey asserting a consumer-facing outcome (omission rejected for such journeys; D030) — and fixture_only (bool, DEFAULT false; D031). Unknown consumer values are rejected. CONSUMER x SURFACE validation (D026): a journey with consumer=human must declare >=1 human-family surface, consumer=agent >=1 agent-family surface, consumer=both >=1 of EACH; a mismatch is rejected so required-evidence derivation is unambiguous. EvidenceRef VALIDATION (D027): availability may be set only together with BOTH data_source AND consumer_family (an availability lacking either is rejected) — F004 per-family degradation + cross-family agreement depend on it (D044). TYPED-SKIP MALFORMED VALIDATION (D060, pinned as validator/equality tests): a typed-skip (availability=unavailable) is malformed and REJECTED if it carries data_provenance=real (must be degraded), or omits degraded_mode, or omits the reason note, or omits evidence_class, or omits surface_class — each malformed case has a dedicated implementation test. EvidenceRef gains, in the agent-conventions schema + Pydantic model + validator (with a VERSION bump): (a) evidence_class — a SINGLE CLOSED enum defined once and referenced by F002/F003/F004, covering human {screenshot, recording, journey_walk, terminal_transcript, rubric, human_signoff}, agent {tool_call_transcript, cli_transcript, contract_check}, mutation {idempotency, rollback}, structured {structured_error}; (b) data_provenance (seeded|real|degraded); (c) data_source (optional str key); (d) availability (optional, available|unavailable); (e) consumer_family (human|agent; REQUIRED when availability is set, D043) — explicit source-family attribution so F004 cross-family comparison never infers family from evidence_class (which breaks for shared classes like structured_error) (D037); (f) degraded_mode (optional str) — names the SELECTED degraded mode so F004 validates it structurally against the journey's allowed_degraded_modes; REQUIRED when the EvidenceRef represents a degraded data_source (D043); (g) surface_class — the F001 surface_class enum naming the surface this evidence attests; REQUIRED for any EvidenceRef used in F002 per-surface satisfaction so the binding is STRUCTURAL not inferred (D058). The EvidenceRef.type enum is NOT extended (test asserts the 8 existing type values are unchanged) and a documented table maps each evidence_class to a valid existing type. Tests cover the total surface->family mapping, consumer validation, the new optional fields parsing (including EvidenceRef.surface_class), the ClaimKind closed-enum (unknown claim_kind rejected), the closed-enum invariant (no evidence_class outside the set is accepted), the typed-skip representation (availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded, no new provenance value), and the no-new-type-value invariant.

features.description: Evidence-class typing rule. Pure function from a claim's (surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) to the required evidence_class(es) drawn ONLY from F001's closed enum, plus a checker that matches a claim's evidence by evidence_class AND data_provenance. claim_kind (read_only|mutation|qualitative) is a separate dimension from surface_class because mutation and qualitative are claim kinds, not surfaces, and may share a surface with read-only claims (D014). Seeded evidence does not satisfy a consumer-readiness claim unless the journey is fixture_only. Mismatch is advisory (warn) at implementation time; close-time blocking is OUT OF SCOPE here — the sibling enforcement plan 2b (2026-06-15-002) consumes this typing result and decides blocking (D040).
features.acceptance: required_evidence_classes(surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) is pure and returns a REQUIREMENT EXPRESSION over F001's closed evidence_class enum with EXPLICIT set semantics (D020): the result is a list of requirement groups; each group is satisfied by ANY ONE of its alternatives (written a|b|c = at-least-one-of), and ALL groups must be satisfied (groups are conjunctive). Example: read_only_ui human -> [ {screenshot|recording|journey_walk} ] (one group, any one); agent_mcp_tool read_only SUCCESS -> [ {tool_call_transcript|contract_check} ] (a successful tool-call or contract transcript alone satisfies); structured_error is required ONLY for an error-path claim, signalled by claim_kind=error_path (claim_kind is extended to {read_only, mutation, qualitative, error_path}; D033) -> adds the group [{structured_error}] (D028). It is NOT unconditionally conjunctive. The read_only matrix is TOTAL over the closed surface_class enum (D045): read_only_ui/interactive_ui -> [{screenshot|recording|journey_walk}]; mobile_app -> [{screenshot|recording}] (simulator/emulator); cli_human -> [{terminal_transcript}]; cli_agent -> [{cli_transcript}]; agent_mcp_tool -> [{tool_call_transcript|contract_check}]; external_integration -> [{contract_check}]; service_batch -> [{contract_check}]; a test asserts EVERY surface_class member has a defined read_only requirement; claim_kind=mutation adds TWO separate conjunctive groups [{idempotency},{rollback}] — BOTH idempotency AND rollback required (D035) — on top of the surface/consumer base; JOURNEY-LEVEL AGGREGATION (D033, tightened D057): a journey declares surfaces[] and one consumer; required evidence is computed PER (surface, claim_kind) and EACH declared surface forms its OWN requirement set that must be satisfied INDEPENDENTLY — groups are NOT unioned or deduplicated across surfaces, and each EvidenceRef is attributed to a surface group STRUCTURALLY via its EvidenceRef.surface_class (D058) and is consumed by AT MOST ONE surface group (a single screenshot/contract_check CANNOT satisfy two surfaces; distinct surfaces require distinct evidence whose surface_class matches) so per-surface proof is never masked; for consumer=both the journey is satisfied only when >=1 human-family surface AND >=1 agent-family surface EACH have all their groups independently satisfied; claim_kind=qualitative -> [{rubric|human_signoff}]. The evidence_class names are EXACTLY F001's enum (contract_check, not contract_test; terminal_transcript for cli_human vs cli_transcript for agent CLI are distinct). A checker, given a claim's (surface_class, consumer, claim_kind) + the FULL list[EvidenceRef] for the journey (each EvidenceRef carrying evidence_class, data_provenance, availability, surface_class, consumer_family — the checker consumes WHOLE EvidenceRefs, NEVER a partial (evidence_class, data_provenance) projection; D058), returns a STRUCTURED per-(surface_class, requirement-group) RESULT LIST (D060) — NOT one global status — where each entry carries its own status in {satisfied | evidence_class_mismatch (names the missing class) | seeded_masks_readiness (a required class is present but only with data_provenance=seeded while the journey is not fixture_only) | missing_provenance (a required evidence_class is present but data_provenance is unset; D057) | not_yet_typed (a human-family surface whose evidence lacks the new typed fields — a legacy_untyped COMPATIBILITY result, see SCOPE below)}; the journey-level verdict is DERIVED as a TRI-STATE (D061) so the D060 scoped deferral is structurally honest at the journey level, never collapsed into a misleading failure: satisfied = ALL groups satisfied; agent_satisfied_human_pending = ALL agent-family groups satisfied AND every remaining non-satisfied group is a human-family not_yet_typed (agent proven now, human pending honestly); unsatisfied = ANY agent-family group failed, OR any human-family group has a failure OTHER THAN not_yet_typed. Mixed missing_provenance / seeded / mismatch cases across surfaces remain individually reported in the per-group list and are never collapsed. SCOPE — shared vocabulary now, AGENT enforcement now, HUMAN typing later (D060): 2a-core defines the full shared EvidenceRef vocabulary for BOTH families (F001) but only ENFORCES rich typing on AGENT-family surfaces (agent_mcp_tool, cli_agent, external_integration, service_batch — the surfaces THIS plan produces via F003). STRUCTURAL FAIL-CLOSED (D058, scoped D060): for an AGENT-family surface, an EvidenceRef MISSING any of surface_class, availability, consumer_family, or a required data_provenance is INELIGIBLE to satisfy that surface group (counts toward nothing, never silently dropped). For a HUMAN-family surface whose EvidenceRefs lack the new typed fields, the checker returns not_yet_typed (legacy_untyped COMPATIBILITY) — NOT evidence_class_mismatch and NOT a fail-closed rejection; human-surface field population is an explicit FOLLOW-UP, which resolves the scope mismatch with the non-goal 'do not rebuild human-surface capture'. SHARED EXCLUSION (D042): an availability=unavailable (typed-skip) EvidenceRef NEVER counts as a satisfying consumer-surface capture even when its evidence_class matches — F002's satisfaction checker and F004 share this rule, so a degraded typed-skip carrying the required class is not 'satisfied'. Tests: (1) UI read_only claim with only test_output -> evidence_class_mismatch; (2) UI claim with a real screenshot -> satisfied; (3) UI claim satisfied only by a seeded screenshot on a non-fixture_only journey -> seeded_masks_readiness; (4) same on a fixture_only journey -> satisfied; (5) a mutation claim on a UI surface requires idempotency+rollback in addition to the read_only base; (6) an agent_mcp_tool read_only claim with only a unit test (test_output) -> evidence_class_mismatch; (7) the same satisfied by a tool_call_transcript OR contract_check -> satisfied (D051). A consumer-readiness EvidenceRef bearing an evidence_class but MISSING data_provenance is treated as NON-real (fail-closed): it cannot satisfy a non-fixture_only readiness claim and the checker surfaces the explicit missing_provenance status (D054, D057). The function is pure (no I/O, no input mutation).

features.description: Agent-surface evidence class in the runtime-evidence harness. Three dogfoodable EvidenceSource adapters reusing harness.py Protocol composition and the evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey>/ convention: (a) CLI non-interactive transcript, (b) MCP tool-call transcript driving DontPanic's own in-process mcp_server (tools/list + a read-only tool), (c) schema/contract-stability check. Each sets an evidence_class drawn from F001's closed agent set + a valid EXISTING EvidenceRef.type + data_provenance, with honest typed-skip represented per D017.
features.acceptance: Three new EvidenceSource adapters register with the harness; each returns list[EvidenceRef] whose type is a valid EXISTING enum value (e.g. log for transcripts, test_output for the contract check, file for artifacts), whose evidence_class is the F001 closed agent vocabulary (tool_call_transcript | cli_transcript | contract_check), and whose data_provenance is set. Each SUCCESSFUL adapter EvidenceRef ALSO carries the shared EvidenceRef vocabulary symmetric with typed-skips (D057): data_source (the stable key it proves), availability=available, consumer_family=agent, and surface_class set to the adapter's OWN agent surface (MCP->agent_mcp_tool, CLI->cli_agent, contract-check->service_batch) — so successful agent evidence is NOT structurally weaker than F001's shared model and is structurally bound to its surface (degraded_mode is unset for available evidence); a test asserts successful adapter outputs carry data_source + availability=available + consumer_family + surface_class (D060). Artifacts land under evidence/goal-governance/post_impl/<source>/<journey>/. The MCP source invokes the in-process mcp_server (tools/list + the PINNED read-only tool `status`, deterministic — not an open-ended example, D045) and records request+response with no secret-shaped field. When a prerequisite is absent, the source emits a typed-skip EvidenceRef represented as availability=unavailable + data_provenance=degraded (NO new provenance value; D017) carrying an operator-readable reason in EvidenceRef.note (and, for transcript/log sources, the same reason in the artifact body) — the reason location is explicit and asserted, not opaque (D029) — AND setting the shared EvidenceRef fields data_source + consumer_family + degraded_mode + surface_class (the adapter's agent surface) (F001) so downstream checks can consume them (D052, D060). A harness test runs all three against a fixture journey and asserts artifacts + the source-agnostic invariant (dispatch by registration, never hardcoded source name) + that NO adapter artifact (CLI, MCP, contract) carries a secret-shaped field (the no-secret assertion covers all three, not only the MCP path; D053). No live paid call is made (D039, pinned D058): the CLI source runs a FIXED non-interactive, read-only argv held as a module-level constant (e.g. CLI_ADAPTER_ARGV) and asserted by an equality test, under an explicit offline env guard (DONTPANIC_OFFLINE=1 set + no network + no paid external execution, asserted), expecting exit code 0 and stdout matching a PINNED JSON schema asserted field-by-field; the contract-check adapter targets a FIXED set of contract files held as a module constant (the agent-conventions v1.0 schema models referenced by F001 — features + objective_contract) and asserts schema-load + fixture-validation stability, emitting a contract_check EvidenceRef whose result shape is pinned and asserted; both adapters' artifacts are shape-asserted, never free-form.
